title: Engine check
source: A fixture for the audits: one statement of each kind the new lessons use.
summary: Read a year of Larkhaven Bikes trips, summarise and chart them, save the chart, and work two of RStudio's settings and menus.

steps.title: Setup: library(tidyverse)
steps.explain: `library(tidyverse)` attaches ggplot2, dplyr, readr and the other core tidyverse packages, so their functions can be used by name.

steps.title: Read the trips: read_csv()

runs.task: Read `data/trips.csv` into a variable called `trips` with `read_csv()`.

steps.explain: `trips` has {n_trips} rows, one per trip in 2025.

steps.title: Casual trips per station: summarize()

runs.code:
trips |>
  filter(member_type == "casual") |>
  summarize(
    trips = n(),
    median_minutes = median(duration_min),
    .by = start_station
  )
alternatives: trips |> filter(member_type == 'casual') |> group_by(start_station) |> summarize(trips = n(), median_minutes = median(duration_min))
runs.purpose: count casual riders' trips and their median length at each start station
runs.task: Keep only casual riders' trips, then count the trips and find the median `duration_min` for each `start_station`.

steps.explain: One row for each of the {stations} stations where a casual rider started a trip.

runs.purpose: keep the first week of June in `week`
runs.task: Keep the trips that started from 1 to 7 June in a variable called `week`.

steps.title: Distance and duration: ggplot()

runs.code:
ggplot(week, aes(x = distance_km, y = duration_min, colour = bike_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4)
alternatives: ggplot(week) + geom_point(aes(distance_km, duration_min, colour = bike_type), alpha = 0.4)
runs.purpose: plot each trip's duration against its distance, coloured by bike type
runs.task: Draw a scatter plot of `duration_min` against `distance_km` for `week`, coloured by `bike_type`, with `alpha = 0.4`.
Save the chart as `distance.png`, 6 by 4 inches, with `ggsave()`.

steps.explain: Each point is a trip. For the same distance, e-bike trips take less time. ggplot2 warns that it left out a few trips: lost bikes, whose distance is unknown.

steps.title: Today, a typo and a warning

runs.purpose: summarise a variable whose name is misspelled
runs.task: Run `summary(trip)`, with `trips` misspelled, to see R's error.

runs.purpose: turn text into numbers, where one can't be

steps.explain: `today()` shows a different date each day. R couldn't find `trip`, so it stopped with an error. `as.numeric()` turned "twelve" into `NA` and warned about it.

steps.title: RStudio: Global Options and Restart R

runs.label: Restore .RData into workspace at startup
runs.purpose: tick Restore .RData in Global Options (the lab starts with it off)
runs.task: In Tools › Global Options › General, tick Restore .RData into workspace at startup, then press OK.
Restart R from the Session menu.

steps.explain: R started again with nothing in the Environment. RStudio saves no .RData here, so there was nothing to restore.
